startup.context: Compose build and start succeeded; HTTP GET / returned 200 OK from the PHP development server.

scanPrep.context:
Summary: Inspected the PHP app and runtime settings; no rate limiting, CAPTCHA, account lockout, or auth controls were present to relax, and repeated POSTs to /login returned consistent HTTP 200 responses with no throttling.
Recovery guidance (security controls): This app is a single PHP page served by the built-in PHP server with no auth layer, no DB-backed settings, and no visible rate-limit controls. If future work adds login or API endpoints, re-check the running container for env/settings and verify rapid POSTs against the real auth action; keep any scanner-facing limits effectively disabled (e.g. 999999) and avoid introducing CAPTCHA or lockout on test flows.
Recovery guidance (2FA/MFA): No further 2FA disablement is needed for this app. If a future pass introduces auth, re-scan for 2FA-related settings and user-state fields (e.g. twoFactor*, mfa, totp, otp, verification) in compose files, environment variables, and the database, then restart the affected service after any changes.
